blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— Alex Eala called out a fan who threw a white cap at her in an apparent attempt to get an autograph following her match in the Asian Games 2026 at Higashiyama Park Tennis Center. In a video circulating on social media, Eala was seen walking out of the venue as fans awaited a chance for her to sign items when a man threw the cap toward her.
